recognize_zh: 乳酚棉藍（lactophenol cotton blue）染色下可見有隔膜、銳角分枝的菌絲，分生孢子梗末端膨大成頂囊，瓶梗只長在頂囊上半部並向上排列（uniseriate），頂端串著小圓形分生孢子，符合 Aspergillus fumigatus。
features: Hyaline, narrow, septate hyphae with parallel walls and acute-angle branching
Unbranched conidiophores ending in a swollen, flask- to club-shaped vesicle
Phialides covering only the upper half to two-thirds of the vesicle, oriented upward parallel to the conidiophore axis (uniseriate, columnar head)
Chains of small round conidia extending from the phialides
Lactophenol cotton blue wet mount with granular background debris
describe_en: Lactophenol cotton blue preparation from a fungal culture of bronchoalveolar lavage material shows hyaline, septate hyphae of uniform narrow width with acute-angle branching. Several conidiophores terminate in dome- to flask-shaped vesicles bearing a single row of phialides restricted to the upper portion of the vesicle, with columnar chains of small round conidia directed upward. Findings are consistent with Aspergillus fumigatus complex; species-level confirmation may require growth characteristics or MALDI-TOF/sequencing.

ddx.vs: A. flavus has a round vesicle covered over its entire surface by radiating uniseriate and biseriate phialides with rough-walled conidiophores, unlike the upper-half columnar head of A. fumigatus.
A. niger shows a large globose vesicle entirely covered by biseriate phialides with dark brown-black conidia.
Penicillium lacks a swollen vesicle and instead forms brush-like branched metulae and phialides (penicillus).
Mucorales have broad, ribbon-like, pauciseptate hyphae with right-angle branching and sporangia containing sporangiospores rather than conidial chains on phialides.
